blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Estimating the Planetary Boundary Layer Height (PBLH) from satellite observations is a challenging regression problem due to the indirect relationship between top-of-atmosphere radiances and near-surface atmospheric structure. Progress has been limited both by the lack of architectures capable of handling the multimodal, spatially incomplete nature of satellite overpasses, and by the scarcity of suitable datasets. In this paper, we build upon the large-scale dataset pairing MetOp radiances with ERA5 PBLH labels that we introduced in our previous work, making three contributions. First, we establish a benchmark across eight approaches spanning pixel-wise regression, swath-wise sequence models, and convolutional and Transformer models operating on the full orbital passage. Second, we quantify what the resulting model actually relies on, using grouped Shapley decomposition over the input blocks. Third, we present the best-performing architecture found: a dual-encoder Transformer whose masked-input handling lets it operate in all weather conditions. The proposed model achieves MAE = 155.8 m on the held-out global test set, outperforming all baselines on every evaluation subset. On 30 out-of-distribution granules acquired on two days overlapping the TEAMx observational campaign, it achieves MAE = 165.3 m, outperforming a pixel-wise baseline trained on the same data (MAE = 197 m).
blocks.zh: 从卫星观测中估计行星边界层高度是一个具有挑战性的回归问题,因为顶层光度和近地层大气结构之间的间接关系。 由于缺乏能够处理卫星过山多式、空间不完整的建筑,以及缺乏适当的数据集,进展受到限制。 在本文中,我们借鉴了我们在先前的作品中引入的将MetOp光度与ERA5 PBLH标签配对的大规模数据集,做出了三项贡献. 首先,我们确定一个基准,涵盖八种方法, 包括像素级回归, 斯瓦思级序列模型, 以及演化和变形器模型 运行在全轨道通道上。 第二,我们用组合的沙普利分解法 来量化所形成的模型实际依赖的是什么。 第三,我们介绍所发现的绩效最佳的架构:一个双编码变形器,其掩码输入处理使其在所有天气条件下运作。 拟议模型在搁置的全球测试中达到MAE=155.8米,超过了每个评价子集的所有基线。 在与TEAMx观测运动重叠两天获得的30个分配外颗粒上,它实现了MAE = 165.3米,超过了在同一数据(MAE = 197米)上培训的像素基准。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The Planetary Boundary Layer (PBL) is the turbulent lowest layer of the troposphere, directly coupled to the Earth’s surface through the exchange of heat, moisture, and momentum. A fundamental parameter characterising the PBL is its height (PBLH), which sets the vertical volume available for the dilution of surface emissions and the exchange of energy between the surface and the free troposphere, with direct relevance to air quality, wind energy, and weather prediction.
blocks.zh: 行星边界层(PBL)是对流层的动荡最低层,通过热、水分和动力的交换直接与地球表面结合。 标注PBL的一个基本参数是它的高度(PBLH),它设定了可用于稀释表面排放和表面与自由对流层之间能量交换的垂直体积,与空气质量,风能,天气预测直接相关.

blocks.en: Despite this importance, PBLH monitoring relies predominantly on sparse in-situ networks (radiosonde launches, ceilometers, lidars) or on numerical weather models, which are slow and computationally heavy to run. On the other hand, satellite remote sensing can enable continuous, globally dense PBLH mapping at each orbital overpass, dramatically expanding observational coverage [ 2 ] . Progress toward this goal has been limited both by the lack of architectures capable of jointly handling the heterogeneous, spatially incomplete nature of multi-instrument overpasses, and by the scarcity of large-scale, publicly available datasets pairing satellite radiances with reliable PBLH labels. Building on the large-scale dataset pairing MetOp satellite radiances with ERA5 PBLH labels introduced in [ 8 ] , we propose three new contributions. 1. A comparative benchmark across eight models spanning pixel-wise regression, swath-wise sequence models, and convolutional and Transformer architectures operating on the complete passage, establishing the first comparison of this kind for satellite-based PBLH estimation, reported with parameter counts and per-pixel inference cost so that accuracy can be weighed against computational footprint. 2. An attribution analysis of what the model relies on , using grouped Shapley decomposition over the 13 input blocks, computed exhaustively rather than sampled and scored directly in metres of RMSE. 3. A dual-encoder Transformer architecture for PBLH estimation from complete MetOp orbital passages, which attains the best accuracy in the benchmark. The model routes infrared (IASI) and microwave (AMSU-A, MHS) radiances through two parallel Vision Transformer encoders, fuses them via element-wise addition, and passes the result through a Transformer decoder to produce dense per-pixel PBLH maps. A dynamic masking schedule, used here as a training-time augmentation that mimics the gaps real passages contain (cloud contamination of the infrared channels, but also fill-flagged or invalid values) rather than a self-supervised reconstruction objective, allows it to consume passages with such gaps directly, in contrast to the convolutional and sequence baselines, which require the missing values to be imputed first. The proposed model outperforms the pixel-wise baseline of [ 8 ] on the same data and compares favourably with prior PBLH retrieval methods, which rely predominantly on lidar backscatter or reanalysis predictors rather than on passive sounder radiances [ 1 , 16 , 10 ] . Code and dataset are available at github.com/links-ads/pblh-transformer .
blocks.zh: 尽管有这种重要性,PBLH监测主要依靠稀少的场内网络(射电发射、天线计、立达)或数值天气模型,这些模型运行缓慢,计算重。 另一方面,卫星遥感能够使每个轨道过线的PBLH连续地进行全球密集的绘图,从而大大扩大观测范围[2]。 实现这一目标的进展受到限制,因为缺乏能够共同处理多仪器超接通道的千差万别、空间不完整的架构,以及缺乏大规模、可公开获取的将卫星光度与可靠的PBLH标签配对的数据集。 根据[8]中引入的将MetOp卫星光度与ERA5 PBLH标签配对的大型数据集,我们提议作出三项新的贡献。 1. 对8个模型进行比较基准,这些模型涵盖像素偏向回归、斯瓦斯偏向序列模型、在完整通道上运行的演化和变形器结构,为基于卫星的PBLH估计建立了这种模型的第一次比较,并附有参数计数和每像素推算成本,以便精确度与计算足迹进行权衡。 2. 对模型所依赖的特性进行归属分析,在13个输入区块上采用分组的沙普利分解法,详尽地计算而不是取样,直接以RMSE的米数计分。 3. 从完整的MetOp轨道通道对PBLH进行估算的双编码器变形器结构,在基准中达到最佳准确度。 模型路线红外线(IASI)和微波线(AMSU-A,MHS)通过两个平行的Vision Transformer编码器进行辐射,通过元素增殖使其引信,并通过变形器解码器传递结果,生成密集的每像素PBLH地图. 动态遮掩表,在这里作为训练时间的增强,模仿实际通道中包含的缺口(对红外通道的云状污染,但也包含填充或无效的值),而不是自我监督的重建目标,使得它能够直接消耗有此类缺口的通道,与需要先估算缺失值的演化和序列基线形成对比. 拟议的模型在相同数据上超过了[8]的像素偏差基线,并优于以前的PBLH检索方法,这些方法主要依靠lidar反向散射或再分析预测器,而不是被动的Sounder光度[1、16、10]。 代码和数据集在github.com/links-ads/pblh-transfer. .

blocks.en: A comparative benchmark across eight models spanning pixel-wise regression, swath-wise sequence models, and convolutional and Transformer architectures operating on the complete passage, establishing the first comparison of this kind for satellite-based PBLH estimation, reported with parameter counts and per-pixel inference cost so that accuracy can be weighed against computational footprint.
blocks.zh: 一个涵盖八种模型的比较基准,这些模型涵盖像素偏向回归、分层测序模型以及在完整通道上运行的演化和变形器结构,为基于卫星的PBLH估计建立了这种模型的第一次比较,并附有参数计数和每像素推算成本,以便精确度能够与计算足迹进行权衡。

blocks.zh: 对模型所依赖的特性进行归属分析,在13个输入区块上采用分组的沙普利分解法,进行详尽的计算,而不是取样,直接以RMSE的米数计分。

The model routes infrared (IASI) and microwave (AMSU-A, MHS) radiances through two parallel Vision Transformer encoders, fuses them via element-wise addition, and passes the result through a Transformer decoder to produce dense per-pixel PBLH maps. A dynamic masking schedule, used here as a training-time augmentation that mimics the gaps real passages contain (cloud contamination of the infrared channels, but also fill-flagged or invalid values) rather than a self-supervised reconstruction objective, allows it to consume passages with such gaps directly, in contrast to the convolutional and sequence baselines, which require the missing values to be imputed first.
blocks.zh: 从完整的MetOp轨道通道进行PBLH估计的双编码器变形器架构,在基准中达到最佳的准确度. 模型路线红外线(IASI)和微波线(AMSU-A,MHS)通过两个平行的Vision Transformer编码器进行辐射,通过元素增殖使其引信,并通过变形器解码器传递结果,生成密集的每像素PBLH地图. 动态遮掩表,在这里作为训练时间的增强,模仿实际通道中包含的缺口(对红外通道的云状污染,但也包含填充或无效的值),而不是自我监督的重建目标,使得它能够直接消耗有此类缺口的通道,与需要先估算缺失值的演化和序列基线形成对比.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The PBL was recommended as an Incubation Targeted Observable by the 2017 US Decadal Survey for Earth Science and Applications from Space (ESAS 2017) [ 13 ] , a tier reserved for observables judged scientifically important but not yet ready for a dedicated mission. A subsequent NASA-commissioned study [ 12 ] set out the associated measurement requirements, roughly 1–25 km horizontal and 0.2–2 km vertical resolution at 1–24 h revisit for temperature and water vapour profiling, and assessed the observational gaps left by the current program of record. Every satellite-based PBLH estimate in the literature, the present work included, is consequently derived from instruments designed for other purposes: lidar backscatter intended for aerosol and cloud profiling, GNSS radio occultation intended for numerical weather prediction refractivity, or infrared and microwave sounders intended for atmospheric temperature and humidity retrieval.
blocks.zh: PBL被2017年美国空间地球科学和应用十大观测(ESAS 2017)推荐为可观测的孵化目标观测器[13],这一级保留给被科学判断为重要但还没有准备好执行专门任务的观测者. 随后,美国航天局委托进行的一项研究[12]列出了相关的测量要求,大约1至25公里的水平分辨率和0.2至2公里的垂直分辨率为1至24小时重温和水蒸汽剖面,并评估了目前记录方案留下的观测空白。 因此,文献中每个基于卫星的PBLH估计数,包括目前的工作,都来自为其他目的设计的仪器:用于气溶胶和云层剖面的激光反散器、用于数值天气预测折射的全球导航卫星系统无线电掩蔽器,或用于大气温度和湿度检索的红外和微波测空器。

blocks.en:
Operational PBLH profiling relies primarily on radiosonde networks and ground-based remote sensing instruments such as lidars, ceilometers, and microwave radiometers (exemplified by the pan-European E-PROFILE network [ 15 ] ), which provide continuous time series at instrumented sites but leave vast ocean, polar, and developing-world regions unobserved.
Satellite observations overcome the coverage limitation of ground stations by offering a global perspective at each overpass, and PBLH estimation from space has been pursued by applying the same gradient-detection principles to retrieved atmospheric profiles. Zhang et al. [ 20 ] estimate PBLH from CALIPSO lidar backscatter over China, reporting correlations of R = 0.59 R=0.59 at Beijing and R = 0.65 R=0.65 at Jinhua against ground-based lidar. GNSS radio occultation offers a complementary space-based route, resolving the refractivity gradient at the PBLH top with a vertical resolution of a few hundred metres, but its horizontal footprint is too coarse for sharp gradients and its sampling is sparse and irregular [ 18 ] .
blocks.zh:
实用的PBLH剖面图主要依靠无线电探测器网络和地面遥感仪器,如立达、天线计和微波辐射计(泛欧E-PROFILE网络[15]),这些仪器在仪器地点提供连续的时间序列,但使广阔的海洋、极地和发展中世界区域无法观察。
卫星观测通过在每条过海通道上提供全球视角,克服了地面站的覆盖范围限制。 通过采用同样的梯度探测原则来检索大气剖面,从空间进行PBLH估计。 张等. [20] CALIPSO lidar backsmission at China估计PBLH,报告R=0.59 R=0.59在北京,R=0.65 R=0.65在金华针对地面的lidar. 全球导航卫星系统无线电掩蔽提供了一种互补的空基路线,以几百米的垂直分辨率解决了PBLH顶部的反射梯度,但其水平足迹太粗糙,无法进行锐度梯度,其取样也很少且不规则[18].

blocks.en: However, the indirect and non-linear relationship between top-of-atmosphere radiances and near-surface atmospheric structure makes retrieval challenging, motivating a shift toward machine learning approaches that learn the mapping directly from data. Almost all of this effort rests on active sensing or on reanalysis rather than on passive radiances. Salcedo-Bosch et al. [ 16 ] apply a Random Forest to ten years of CALIOP backscatter profiles paired with radiosonde measurements, achieving an RMSE of 278 m over Europe and North America, and Li et al. [ 10 ] apply an attention-augmented ResNet with transfer learning to CATS backscatter profiles augmented with reanalysis fields, achieving an MAE of 561 m and R = 0.67 R=0.67 against radiosondes. Ayazpour et al. [ 1 ] instead forgo satellite radiances altogether, training XGBoost on ERA5 meteorological and geographical predictors against AMDAR aircraft profiles to produce spatially complete PBLH over the contiguous United States, with a cross-validated MAE of 186 m at held-out airports.
blocks.zh: 然而,大气层顶层辐射和近地层大气结构之间的间接和非线性关系使得检索具有挑战性,促使人们转向直接从数据中学习绘图的机器学习方法。 几乎所有的努力都取决于主动感知或重新分析,而不是被动光度。 萨尔塞多-博施等人. [16] 对10年CALIOP反散射剖面图与放射性森德测量成对,在欧洲和北美上空达到278米的RMSE,李等人. [10] 应用一个注意增强的ResNet,将转录学习应用到带有再分析字段的CATS反散射剖面图中,实现561米的MAE,R=0.67R=0.67的抗放射性声素. Ayazpour等人著. [1] 相反,完全放弃卫星辐射,对XGBoost进行ERA5气象和地理预测器与AMDAR飞机剖面的培训,以便在毗连的美国上空产生空间完整的PBLH,在被搁置的机场进行186米的交叉验证MAE.

blocks.en: Passive infrared and microwave sounders sit at the opposite end of this trade-off: they sample a wide swath at high revisit and, in the microwave, retain sensitivity through cloud. Retrieval of PBLH from sounder radiances alone remains largely unexplored; the closest work is our own [ 8 ] , which estimates PBLH from combined infrared and microwave radiances footprint by footprint. The only other work to combine the two modalities is Milstein et al. [ 11 ] , who apply a 3D deep neural network to enhance the vertical detail of existing AIRS/AMSU Level-2 retrieved temperature and humidity profiles; their model operates on already-retrieved profiles rather than raw radiances and does not target PBLH directly, so its reported accuracy is not directly comparable to ours. A further limitation common to all of these approaches is that they treat each retrieval location independently, discarding the spatial structure of the orbital passage. To our knowledge, the present work is the first to estimate PBLH directly from raw infrared and microwave radiances in a dual-encoder architecture and to leverage spatial context across the full satellite overpass. On this dataset, exploiting horizontal context lets the model reach an accuracy competitive with lidar- and reanalysis-based approaches despite the coarse vertical resolution of passive sounding, a result we see as an encouraging first step rather than a final answer on how broadly MetOp-class radiances can support PBLH retrieval.
blocks.zh: 被动红外和微波测音器坐落在这种权衡的相反端:它们在高重访时取样一个宽的片段,在微波中通过云保持灵敏度. 仅从较深光度中获取PBLH基本上仍未被探索;最接近的作品是我们自己的[8],它通过脚印从红外线和微波光度相结合的足迹中估算出PBLH. 将两种模式结合的唯一其他工作是Milstein等人[11],他们应用3D深神经网络来增强现有AIRS/AMSU Level-2检索温度和湿度剖面的垂直细节;他们的模型运行在已经检索的剖面上,而不是原始光度上,并且不直接瞄准PBLH,因此其报告的准确性不能直接与我们相比. 所有这些方法的共同限制是它们分别处理每个检索地点,放弃轨道通过时的空间结构。 据我们所知,目前的工作是第一个直接从双重编码器结构中的原始红外线和微波光度估算PBLH,并利用整个卫星过道的空间环境。 在这个数据集上,利用水平上下文使模型达到与lidar和再分析方法的准确性竞争,尽管被动声波的粗糙的垂直分辨率,我们视这一结果为令人鼓舞的第一步,而不是关于MetOp类光能在多大程度上支持PBLH检索的最终答案.

blocks.en: 3 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 数据集

blocks.en:
We use the dataset introduced in [ 8 ] , which pairs raw top-of-atmosphere radiances from two complementary satellite sensors with ERA5 PBLH targets. Full details of how the dataset was constructed are given in [ 8 ] . The input radiances come from IASI and AMSU-A/MHS aboard the MetOp satellites (A, B, C), which are freely and openly distributed by EUMETSAT. Each MetOp satellite follows a polar sun-synchronous orbit, providing approximately two overpasses per day over any location; the three-satellite constellation ensures consistent global sampling. The dataset covers the year 2022, sampled at weekly intervals (one date per week from January 3 to December 26), with four synoptic overpass times per date (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC), yielding 194 orbital passages in total and over 4.3 million samples distributed across all seasons and latitudes.
The target PBLH is derived from the ERA5 fifth-generation reanalysis [ 7 ] . Each satellite footprint’s ERA5 PBLH target was obtained by sampling the four nearest grid points and taking their mean.
blocks.zh:
我们使用[8]中引入的数据集,数据集将两个辅助卫星传感器的原始顶端光度与ERA5 PBLH目标对齐. 数据集构造的全部细节见[8]。 输入光度来自欧洲气象卫星应用组织自由公开分发的MetOp卫星(A、B、C)上的IASI和AMSU-A/MHS。 每个 MetOp卫星沿极地太阳同步轨道运行,每天在任何地点提供大约两条过路;三卫星星座确保全球取样的一致性。 该数据集涵盖2022年,按每周间隔采样(从1月3日至12月26日每周一个日期),每个日期有4次综合超时(00,06,12和18 UTC),共产生194个轨道通道,超过430万个样本分布在各个季节和纬度.
目标PBLH来源于ERA5第五代再分析[7]. 每个卫星脚印的ERA5 PBLH目标都是通过对四个最近的网点进行取样并取其平均值获得的。

blocks.en: For the out-of-distribution evaluation we additionally use 30 MetOp granules acquired on two dates outside the 2022 dataset, 14 February 2025 and 25 June 2025 (15 granules each), selected to fall within the observation period of the TEAMx campaign.
blocks.zh: 在分配外评价中,我们额外使用在2022年数据集之外两个日期(2025年2月14日和2025年6月25日各15个颗粒)获得的30个MetOp颗粒,这些颗粒被选定属于TEAMx运动的观测期。

blocks.en:
The dataset is partitioned to prevent data leakage while ensuring all seasons are represented in every split. Within each month, the first sampled date is assigned to the test set, the second to validation, and all remaining dates to training. This is applied independently for each month, so test and validation each contain one day per month spread across the full annual cycle, while training retains the majority of the data.
Each channel is independently standardised using per-channel mean and standard deviation computed from the training set. The PBLH target is normalized using a fixed scale factor of 4000 m.
In addition to the spectral channels, each observation is augmented with auxiliary features. Periodic quantities (latitude, longitude, time of day, day of year, satellite and solar angles) are sine/cosine encoded with period equal to their natural range. Surface elevation, cloud flag, and land flag are also included. The final input vector has C = 207 C=207 channels per observation: 20 microwave brightness temperatures, 168 infrared radiances, and 19 auxiliary features.
blocks.zh:
数据集被分割,以防止数据泄露,同时确保所有季节在每一个分割中都有代表. 在每个月内,第一个采样日期被分配到测试集,第二个被分配到验证,其余全部被分配到培训. 每个月都独立应用,因此每个测试和验证每个月包含一个全年周期的一天,而培训保留大多数数据。
每个频道都采用每个频道的平均值和从培训中计算的标准偏差进行独立标准化。 PBLH目标采用4000m的固定比例系数实现正常化.
除了光谱通道外,每次观测都增加了辅助特征. 周期性数量(纬度、经度、日时、年日、卫星和太阳角度)为正弦/正弦,其期间等于其自然范围。 还包括地表海拔、云旗和陆地旗。 最终输入矢量的C=207 C=207通道进行观测:20微波亮度温度,168红外光度,19个辅助特征.

blocks.en: Figure 1: PBLH along the MetOp ground tracks for the overpasses of 14 February 2025. Left: ERA5 PBLH, used as the reference. Centre: Transformer-2D prediction. Right: prediction minus reference. The first two panels share a common 0–3000 m colour scale; the difference panel uses a diverging scale spanning ± \pm 1000 m.
blocks.zh: 图1:2025年2月14日MetOp地面通道沿线的PBLH。 左:ERA5 PBLH,用作参考. 中心:变形器-2D预测. 右:预测减参考. 前两个面板共用一个0-3000米的颜色尺度;差幅面板使用一个横跨±\pm 1000米的差幅.

blocks.en: 4 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: We compare seven baseline models of increasing spatial complexity against our proposed Transformer-2D architecture. Models are grouped into three spatial granularities, each exploiting a different level of context from the satellite data.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了七个空间日益复杂的基线模型,与我们提议的变形器-2D结构。 模型分为三个空间颗粒,每个模型利用与卫星数据不同的环境水平。

blocks.en: 4.1 Pixel-wise Models
blocks.zh: 4.1 像素型号

blocks.en:
Pixel-wise models treat each IASI footprint independently, mapping a single 𝐱 ∈ ℝ 207 \mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{207} feature vector to a scalar PBLH estimate with no spatial context.
A ridge-regularised linear model, Random Forest, and XGBoost serve as non-deep baselines of increasing complexity.
Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) is a fully connected neural network built from residual blocks [ 6 ] , each comprising two linear transformations with batch normalisation and ReLU activations, used as a deep learning baseline for pixel-wise regression.
blocks.zh:
Pixel-wisel模型独立处理每个IASI脚印,将一个单××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××207}特性矢量映射到一个没有空间背景的scalar PBLH估计.
山脊规范的线性模型Random Forest和XGBooost作为日益复杂的非深层基线。
多层感知网(MLP)是一个完全连接的神经网络,由残块[6]所建,每个神经网络由两个具有批量正常化和ReLU激活的线性转化组成,用作像素偏向回归的深层学习基线.

blocks.en: 4.2 Swath-wise Models
blocks.zh: 4.2 顺式模型

blocks.en: Swath-wise models process one full scan line at a time, treating the W = 30 W=30 cross-track positions as a 1D sequence. Missing values are filled by 1D linear interpolation so that the model always receives a complete sequence.
blocks.zh: Swath-wise模型一次处理一个全扫描线,将W = 30 W = 30跨轨位置作为1D序列处理. 缺失的值由1D线性插值填充,这样模型总是得到完整的序列.

blocks.en:
UNet-1D is a 1D encoder-decoder with skip connections [ 14 ] , progressively downsampling and upsampling the swath.
Transformer-1D applies self-attention along the scan line [ 19 ] , with positional encodings to preserve scan order.
blocks.zh:
UNet-1D是一个1D编码器-解码器,带有跳转连接[14],逐渐下取样和上取样.
变形器-1 D沿扫描线应用自留心[19],位置编码以维护扫描顺序.

blocks.en: 4.3 Passage-wise Models
blocks.zh: 4.3 通过型号

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the proposed dual-encoder Transformer. Infrared and microwave radiances are tokenised and processed by two independent ViT encoders. The encoded representations are fused by element-wise addition; learnable missing-token embeddings are inserted at masked positions before a shared Transformer decoder produces per-pixel PBLH estimates.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 拟议的双编码变形器概述. 红外线和微波辐射由两个独立的ViT编码器来表示和处理. 编码的表示法通过元素的添加来连接;在共享的变形器解码器产生每像素的PBLH估计值之前,可学习的缺失键嵌入法被插入到遮蔽位置.

blocks.en: Passage-wise models operate on complete 2D orbital passages, treating the overpass as a spatial image of shape H × W × C H\times W\times C .
blocks.zh: 穿梭式模型在完整的2D轨道通道上运行,将过道作为形状H×W×C H\times W\times C的空间图像处理.

blocks.en: ResNet-2D requires a fully dense input since convolutional kernels cannot process sparse missing values. Missing pixels are therefore filled by 2D bilinear interpolation prior to model input, with any remaining gaps resolved iteratively using the mean of valid 8-connected neighbours. During training, passages are augmented with random horizontal and vertical flips, 90° rotations and random affine transforms (shift, scale, small rotation). A random crop of size P × P P\times P is then applied. At inference, the full passage is fed to the network after symmetric mirror padding so as to avoid border artifacts.
blocks.zh: ResNet-2D需要完全密集的输入,因为演化内核不能处理稀疏的缺失值. 因此,缺失的像素在模型输入前由2D双线插值填充,任何剩余缺口都使用有效的8连接邻居的平均值反复解决. 在训练期间,通道通过随机水平翻转和垂直翻转,90°旋转和随机芳香变换(转弯,缩放,小旋转)而增强. 然后应用大小为P×P\时的随机作物. 推断出,在对称的镜像粘贴后,将全部通道输入网络,以避免边界文物.

blocks.en: Proposed approach
blocks.zh: 拟议办法

blocks.en:
Transformer-2D is our proposed model. It addresses the limitations of feature-based regression and convolutional networks through a multimodal dual-encoder architecture that handles heterogeneous satellite inputs and missing observations via a masking-based augmentation strategy adapted from the masked-autoencoder architecture [ 5 ] . Random input masking mirrors real acquisition gaps at training time, so the model learns to recover from them directly through the downstream regression loss, rather than via a separate reconstruction objective or imputation.
The 207-channel input is divided into two sensor streams processed by dedicated encoders before fusion. The microwave stream comprises the 20 brightness temperature channels concatenated with the 19 auxiliary features (39 channels total). The infrared stream comprises the 168 radiance channels concatenated with the same auxiliary features (187 channels total). Both encoders share their structural design but are decoupled in weight space, enabling each stream to learn modality-specific representations.
blocks.zh:
变形器 -2D是我们的模型 它通过一种多式联运双编码器结构,处理基于特征的回归和转录网络的局限性,这种结构通过一种基于遮掩的增强战略,从遮掩的自动编码器结构中加以调整,处理各种卫星投入和缺失的观测[5]。 随机输入在训练时会镜像真实的获取缺口,因此模型学会通过下游回归损失直接从中恢复,而不是通过单独的重建目标或推算.
207通道输入分为两个传感器流,在聚变前由专用编码器处理. 微波流由20个亮度温度通道组成,并配有19个辅助功能(共计39个通道). 红外流由168个光度信道组成,其辅助特征相同(共计187个信道)。 两种编码器都共享其结构设计,但在重量空间中脱钩,使每条流都能学习特定模式的表示.

blocks.en:
The full satellite passage (padded to 800 × 30 800\times 30 pixels) is processed in the same fashion as the Vision Transformer [ 3 ] applied to an image, with each pixel acting as an individual token (patch size 1 × 1 1\times 1 ). Tokens are grouped into localised windows of adjacent samples: pixels in close spatial proximity share high correlation, so that when observations are corrupted or missing, neighbouring pixels carry context that guides recovery of the underlying state. Each encoder processes only the visible (non-masked) tokens in its stream and projects each pixel to a shared latent dimension.
After encoding, the two encoder outputs are fused via element-wise addition. Learnable missing-token embeddings are then inserted at all masked positions, reconstructing a complete token sequence. The decoder mirrors the encoder structure and processes the complete set of tokens, both observed and reconstructed, allowing it to propagate context from visible pixels to masked positions. A final linear projection maps each decoder output token to a scalar PBLH estimate.
blocks.zh:
完整的卫星通道(加到800×30800×时30像素)的处理方式与Vision Transformer [3] 应用到一个图像时的处理方式相同,每个像素作为单个的代号(patch size 1×1 1\时1). 托肯被分组到邻近样本的本地化窗口中:近空间相近的像素具有高度的关联性,因此当观测被腐蚀或缺失时,相邻的像素上下文会引导基础状态的恢复. 每个编码器只处理其流中可见的(非混杂的)符号,并将每个像素投射到一个共同的潜在维度.
编码后,两个编码器的输出通过元素加法实现引信. 然后在所有蒙面位置插入可学习的缺失插件,重建完整的符号序列。 解码器镜像了编码器结构,并处理全套的令牌,既可观察又可重建,使其能从可见像素向遮掩位置传播上下文. 最终的线性投影图每个解码器输出令牌到一个scalar PBLH估计.

blocks.en:
During training, a dynamic masking schedule randomly selects a masking ratio between 0% and 100% of the available pixels in each window. Randomly masked tokens are replaced by a learnable missing-token embedding, borrowing the missing-token mechanism of [ 5 ] . Microwave and infrared missing tokens are learned separately, which encourages the model to exploit cross-modal redundancy and maintain prediction capability when either sensor stream is partly or fully unavailable. During training, windows are augmented with random horizontal flips, vertical flips, and 90° rotations before the random crop to size P × P P\times P . At inference, the full passage is decomposed into overlapping 16 × 16 16\times 16 tiles using the same window size as training, with a stride of 8 pixels. Each tile is processed independently and the resulting predictions are averaged wherever tiles overlap, yielding a complete prediction map over the passage.
Figure 2 summarises the full dual-encoder architecture.
By design, each orbital passage is processed independently; we return to the implications of this scoping choice in Section 6.1 .
blocks.zh:
在训练期间,动态遮掩表随机选择每个窗口中可用像素的0%至100%之间的遮掩比. 随机遮掩的代币被可学习的缺失托肯嵌入所取代,借用[5]的缺失托肯机制. 微波和红外缺失信号是单独学习的,这鼓励该模型在传感器流部分或完全无法使用时利用跨模式冗余并保持预测能力。 在训练期间,窗口会通过随机水平翻转,垂直翻转,以及随机裁剪前的90°旋转来放大P×P\times P. 推断出,整个通道被分解成重叠的16×16 16\时16瓦,使用与训练相同的窗口大小,步数为8像素. 每块瓦片都是独立处理的,所产生的预测在瓦片重叠之处均进行平均处理,从而产生完整的通道预测图.
图2概括了完整的双编码器架构.
通过设计,每个轨道通道都是独立处理的;我们回到第6.1节中这一范围界定选择的影响。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Configurations
blocks.zh: 5.1 配置

blocks.en:
All models share the same 207-channel input. All hyperparameters were found by grid search. The linear baseline is ridge-regularised ( α = 1 \alpha=1 ). Random Forest used 100 trees, maximum depth 12, and square-root feature subsampling. XGBoost used 100 boosting rounds with MAE objective, tree depth 6, and early stopping patience 10.
Neural networks were trained with the AdamW optimizer using a cosine learning rate schedule from 10 − 5 10^{-5} to 10 − 10 10^{-10} . The MLP has sixteen residual blocks of dimension 128 and batch normalisation trained with batch size 1024. UNet-1D and Transformer-1D use batch size 1024 on swath segments of length 32. UNet-1D has three encoder stages with channel widths 64, 128, and 256, a bottleneck of width 512, and a symmetric decoder; each stage consists of two residual blocks, batch normalisation, ReLU. Transformer-1D has model dimension 256, 8 attention heads, and 4 encoder layers. ResNet-2D uses batch size 16, and training patch 128 × 128 128\times 128 . The Transformer-2D uses batch size 16; each ViT encoder has dimension 384, depth 2, 16 attention heads with head dimension 24, and the decoder shares these settings but with depth 4.
blocks.zh:
所有型号都共享相同的207频道输入. 所有超参数都是通过网格搜索找到的. 线性基线为脊调节(α=1\alpha=1). 随机 森林使用了100棵树,最大深度12,和方根特征子采样. XGBoost使用了100发助推弹,有MAE目标,树深6,早期停止耐心10.
神经网络与亚当W优化器一起接受了训练,使用一个宇宙学习率表,从10 - 5 10 - 5}到10 - 10 10 - 10 MLP有16个128尺寸的剩余区块,并经过批量尺寸1024. UNet-1D和变形器-1D在32长的宽片段上使用1024的批量尺寸. UNet-1D有三个编码器级,信道宽度分别为64,128和256,一个宽度512的瓶颈,以及一个对称的解码器;每个级由两个残块组成,批量正常化,ReLU. 变形器-1D有模型维度256,8个注意头,以及4个编码层. ResNet-2D采用批量尺寸16,训练补丁128×128128\ times128. 变形器-2D采用批量尺寸16;每个ViT编码器有尺寸384,深度2,16个注意头和头尺寸24,解码器共享这些设置但有深度4.

blocks.en: 5.2 Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 量化结果

blocks.en: Table 1 reports MAE, RMSE, and Pearson r r across four evaluation subsets: the full held-out test set, Europe-only, clear-sky, and cloudy-sky. Models are grouped by spatial granularity: pixel-wise, swath-wise, and passage-wise. Transformer-2D outperforms every baseline on all three metrics and all four subsets, indicating that spatial context across the overpass carries information not present at the single-footprint or swath level. Access to that context is not sufficient on its own, however: ResNet-2D, the other passage-wise model, is beaten by the pixel-wise MLP on RMSE over the full test set and by UNet-1D over Europe on both error metrics. Among pixel-wise models, tree ensembles improve on the regularised linear baseline, and the MLP achieves the lowest MAE of the group. The MLP result deserves comment: on the full test set it outperforms both swath-wise models on all three metrics (177.6 m MAE) and approaches ResNet-2D, despite seeing a single footprint at a time with no spatial context whatsoever and using by far the fewest parameters of the neural baselines (0.56 M). A large fraction of the achievable skill is therefore available from the spectral signature of an individual footprint alone, and spatial context, while clearly beneficial, provides a comparatively modest additional margin. All models show higher errors on the Europe-only subset, consistent with the higher ERA5 PBLH variability over that region (std 438 m vs 410 m globally). The Transformer-2D shows a wider advantage in cloudy conditions compared to the other test sets. This pattern is consistent with the dual-encoder design providing a route toward all-weather operation: when cloud cover renders infrared channels unavailable, the microwave encoder continues to provide a complete representation, and the fusion of both streams may help the model compensate for the missing modality. The masking mechanism further contributes by training the model to recover from arbitrary patterns of missing tokens, so inference-time gaps are handled the same way as training-time masks. We note that the swath-wise models and ResNet-2D all require a fully dense input and therefore receive imputed values wherever observations are missing (1D linear interpolation along the scan line for UNet-1D and Transformer-1D, 2D bilinear interpolation for ResNet-2D), whereas Transformer-2D consumes such gaps directly.
blocks.zh: 表1报告MAE、RMSE和Pearson r跨越四个评价子集:全面搁置测试集、欧洲唯一测试集、晴天测试和云天测试。 模型按空间颗粒性进行分组:像素型,swath型,通过型。 变形器-2D在所有3个度量和所有4个子集上都超过了每个基线,表明跨过通道的空间背景所携带的信息不是在单脚印或斯瓦特级别上. 然而,进入这种环境本身是不够的:ResNet-2D是另一个具有通道的模型,它被RMSE上的视像素的MLP击败,被UNet-1D击败,被击败,被击败,被击败,被击败,被击败。 在像素型模型中,树群在正则线性基线上有所改进,MLP实现组中最低的MAE. MLP结果值得评论:在全面测试中,它既超越了所有三个度量衡(177.6 m MAE)的斜向模型,也超越了ResNet-2D的方法,尽管在没有任何空间背景时看到一个单一的足迹,并且使用了迄今为止神经基线中最少的参数(0.56 M). 因此,可实现技能的很大一部分仅从个人足迹的光谱特征即可获得,空间背景虽然明显有益,但提供了相对较小的额外空间。 所有模型都显示欧洲唯一子集上存在较高的错误,与该区域上较高的ERA5 PBLH可变性一致(全球第438米对410米). 变形金刚-2D在云层条件下比其他测试集表现出更大的优势. 这种模式符合双编码器设计,提供了通向全天候操作的路径:当云层覆盖使得红外通道无法使用时,微波编码器继续提供完整的表示,两条流的聚变可能有助于模型弥补缺失的模式. 遮掩机制通过培训模型从任意模式的缺失代币中恢复来进一步做出贡献,因此推论时间缺口的处理方式与训练时间面具相同. 我们注意到,Swath-with模型和ResNet-2D都要求完全密集的输入,因此,只要没有观测结果,就接收估算值(UNet-1D扫描线沿线的1D线性插值和变形器-1D线性插值,ResNet-2D线性插值为2D线性插值),而变形器-2D线性插值则直接消耗这些缺口。

blocks.en: Table 1: MAE (m), RMSE (m), and Pearson r r across evaluation subsets. Models grouped by spatial granularity. Bold: best per row. Parameter counts are given only for models whose capacity is a fixed number of weights. The tree ensembles are instead sized by their fitted structure (RF: 100 trees, 566k nodes; XGBoost: 100 trees, 12.6k nodes); the ridge baseline has 207 weights and one bias.
blocks.zh: 表1:跨评价子集的MAE(m)、RMSE(m)和Pearson r。 按空间颗粒性分类的模型. 粗体:每行最好. 参数计数只针对其容量为固定重量的模型。 树群的大小取而代之的是其搭配的结构(RF:100棵树,566k节点;XGBoost:100棵树,12.6k节点);山脊基线有207个重量和1个偏差.

blocks.en:
The Transformer-2D was further evaluated on 30 granules acquired on two dates, 14 February 2025 and 25 June 2025 (15 granules each), with all reported metrics computed over the full set of 30. These dates fall outside the training and validation splits and represent contrasting seasonal conditions (winter and early summer), and were specifically selected within the observation period of the TEAMx observational campaign [ 9 ] .
Evaluated against ERA5 PBLH on these campaign-period overpasses, the model achieves MAE 165.3 m and RMSE 226.6 m, a bit higher than on the global test set (MAE 155.8 m), with essentially unchanged correlation ( r = 0.852 r=0.852 against 0.850 0.850 ). For reference, the per-pixel MLP baseline reported in [ 8 ] obtains MAE = = 197 m and RMSE = = 254 m on the same granules, suggesting that the spatial context captured by the dual-encoder Transformer improves generalization to this out-of-distribution setting. On a single consumer-grade NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti, Transformer-2D produces a full-passage PBLH map ( 765 × 30 765\times 30 footprints) in approximately 0.46 s (50k pixels/s), so a full day of global MetOp coverage can be processed in a couple of minutes on one such card. Figure 1 maps the ERA5 reference, the Transformer-2D prediction and their difference along the ground tracks for one of the two dates.
blocks.zh:
变压器-2D在两个日期(2025年2月14日和2025年6月25日)获得的30颗颗粒上得到了进一步评价(每个颗粒15颗),所有报告的指标均在30个整组中计算。 这些日期不属于训练和鉴定的划分范围,代表了不同的季节性条件(冬季和夏初),并且是在TEAMx观测运动的观察期间专门选定的[9]。
对照ERA5 PBLH对这些运动期的超时,该型号实现了MAE 165.3米和RMSE 226.6米,略高于全球测试集(MAE 155.8米),其相关性基本不变(r = 0.852 r = 0.852 = 0.850 = 0.850 0.850). 供参考的是,[8]中报告的每像素MLP基线在同一颗粒上获得MAE = 197米和RMSE = 254米,这表明双编码器变换器所捕获的空间环境可以改善这种分配外设置的概括. 在单一消费级的NVIDIA RTX 2080上 Ti,变形金刚-2D在大约0.46秒(50k像素/秒)内产生全程PBLH映射(765×30 765\时30足迹),因此全球MetOp覆盖的全天可以在其中一张卡上处理几分钟. 图1显示了ERA5的参考文献,变形器-2D的预测及其沿地面轨道的差值,这两个日期中的一个.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.3 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 2 isolates the contribution of four architectural choices, measured in RMSE on the global all-sky test set. Single encoder replaces the dual-encoder design with a single encoder processing all 207 channels jointly, removing the modality-specific inductive bias. No masking fixes the additional masking at 0%. Masking cap at 50% instead still draws a random amount each step, but from 0% to 50% rather than the full 0% to 100% range used in the full model, reducing the diversity of missing-data scenarios seen during training. Concat fusion replaces element-wise addition with concatenation followed by a linear projection. Every variant increases RMSE relative to the full model. Single encoder is the most costly at +4.1 m; the other three variants are comparatively minor and closely clustered, from +1.1 m (concat fusion) to +2.5 m (masking cap at 50%).
blocks.zh: 表2隔离了RMSE在全球全天空测试集中测量的四个建筑选择的贡献. 单一编码器用一个单一编码器联合处理所有207个通道来取代双编码器设计,消除了模式特有的导电偏差. 没有遮盖将额外的遮盖修正为0%. 相反,50%的遮盖上限仍然是随机的,但从0%到50%,而不是整个模型中使用的完全的0%到100%的范围,从而减少了培训期间所看到的缺失数据情况的多样性。 Concat核聚变以Concetation取代了元素智能加法,然后是线性投影. 每个变体都比全型增加了RMSE. 单编码器在+4.1米时成本最高;其他三种变体相对次要且紧密组合,从+1.1米(concat聚变)到+2.5米(质量上限为50%).

blocks.en: 5.4 Channel Attribution
blocks.zh: 5.4 频道归属

blocks.en: To quantify how much each input group contributes to accuracy we employ a grouped Shapley value [ 17 ] computed directly in RMSE. The 207 channels are partitioned into 13 blocks: the 20 microwave channels, the 168 infrared channels, and eleven single- or dual-channel auxiliary blocks (cloud flag, land flag, surface elevation, day of year, time of day, latitude, longitude, satellite azimuth, satellite zenith, solar azimuth, solar zenith). The 1024 evaluation crops are 16 × 16 16\times 16 windows, matching the model’s native input size, drawn at random locations from the test-set passages and kept only if entirely free of missing values, so every combination of blocks is scored on the same fixed set of fully observed pixels. For each such combination, the blocks left out keep their values from an independently drawn reference crop, sampled the same way, instead of their real ones, and the RMSE is computed over the 1024 evaluation crops.
blocks.zh: 为了量化每个输入组对准确性的贡献,我们采用在RMSE中直接计算的一个分组的毛值[17]。 207个频道分为13个区块:20个微波通道,168个红外通道,以及11个单通道或双通道辅助区块(云旗,陆旗,地表高地,年日,日时,纬度,经度,卫星方位角,卫星方位角,太阳方位角,太阳方位角). 1024评价作物为16×16 16\时16窗口,与模型的原生输入大小相匹配,从测试设置的通道中随机抽取位置,只有在完全没有缺失值时才保留,因此每个块组合都在同一固定的完全观测到的像素集上得分. 对于每种这种组合,留下的区块都使其数值远离独立绘制的参考作物,取样方式相同,而不是真实的,RMSE是在1024种评价作物上计算的。

blocks.en: Table 2: Ablation study. Global all-sky test-set RMSE (m) with one architectural choice changed at a time, all else held at the full model.
blocks.zh: 表2:读物研究. 全球全天空测试集 RMSE(m),一次有一个建筑选择改变,其他都保存在全模型上.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Grouped Shapley value per input block, in metres of test-set RMSE reduction. Bars show 95% bootstrap intervals.
blocks.zh: 图3:每个输入区块分组的毛细值,以试验组RMSE减值米计. 栏杆显示95%的靴子间隔.

blocks.en: Figure 3 reports the Shapley value for every block with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. Microwave brightness temperatures carry the single largest share (101.1 m, 32% of the total), ahead of infrared radiances (56.4 m, 18%). Latitude (51.0 m) and the land/sea flag (50.2 m) follow closely and are individually comparable in magnitude to the entire 168-channel infrared block, indicating that geolocation and surface-type context carry nearly as much information as the spectral radiances themselves. Satellite zenith and solar zenith contribute more modestly (19.1 m and 12.6 m respectively), and day of year is statistically indistinguishable from zero.
blocks.zh: 图3报告每个区块的沙普利值为95%的靴子置信间隔. 微波亮度温度承载着最大的单一份额(101.1米,占总数的32%),高于红外光度(56.4米,占18%). 纬度(51.0米)和陆地/海旗(50.2米)紧随其后,各自在数量上与整个168通道红外区块相当,表明地理定位和地表型环境携带的信息几乎与光谱光度本身相同. 卫星天顶和太阳天顶的贡献比较小(分别为19.1米和12.6米),每年的一天在统计上与零无区别.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented an exploratory comparative study investigating whether Planetary Boundary Layer Height can be estimated from MetOp satellite radiances alone, across eight machine learning approaches spanning three spatial granularities. Among these, a dual-encoder Transformer achieved the best performance on all evaluation subsets, reaching an MAE of 155.8 m and Pearson r = 0.850 r=0.850 on the global held-out test set, including on its clear-sky and cloudy subsets, and degrading only moderately on 30 out-of-distribution granules acquired during the TEAMx observational campaign period.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个探索性比较研究,研究行星边界层高度是否可以仅从MetOp卫星光度中估算,跨越三个空间颗粒的八种机器学习方法。 其中,双编码器变换器在所有评价子集上都取得了最佳的性能,在全球搁置测试集上,包括在其清空和云层子集上,其MAE为155.8米,Pearson r=0.850 r=0.850,在TEAMx观测运动期间获得的30个分配外颗粒上仅略有降低。

blocks.en: 6.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.1 限制

blocks.en:
Both our training labels and our TEAMx-period evaluation use ERA5 PBLH, a model-derived quantity rather than a direct atmospheric observation. Every number we report therefore measures agreement
with a reanalysis, not with ground measurements, and it is essential to know how good that reanalysis is. Guo et
al. [ 4 ] evaluate ERA5 PBLH against near-global high-resolution radiosondes and find that ERA5
underestimates daytime PBLH by around 130 m. Our model reaches
MAE = 155.8 m and r = 0.850 r=0.850 against ERA5. In other words, the disagreement between our model and its label is
of the same order as the disagreement between that label and radiosonde observations. Two consequences follow.
First, our error figures cannot be read as distance from the true PBLH; a model in perfect agreement with ERA5
would still carry ERA5’s own bias. Second, part of the residual error we report may reflect the label’s noise
floor rather than model deficiency, which also means that small differences between the better-performing
models in Table 1 should be interpreted with caution.
blocks.zh:
我们的训练标签和我们的TEAMx期评价都使用ERA5 PBLH,这是一个模型生成的数量,而不是直接的大气观测. 因此,我们报告的每个数字 衡量协议
重新分析,而不是地面测量, 并且必须知道重新分析有多好。 郭和华
阿尔。 [4] 评价ERA5 PBLH 与近全球高分辨率射线探测仪,发现ERA5
低估了日间PBLH大约130米. 我们的模型到达
MAE=155.8米,r=0.850 r=0.850 对ERA5. 换句话说,我们的模型与其标签之间的分歧是:
与该标签与放射性声素观测之间的分歧相同。 后结二果.
首先,我们的错误数字不能被解读为与真正的PBLH的距离;一个与ERA5完全一致的模型.
将仍然带有ERA5自身的偏见。 第二,我们报告的部分剩余错误可能反映标签的噪音
而不是模型缺陷,这也意味着表现较好者之间的小差异
对表1中的模型应谨慎解释。

blocks.en:
Each orbital passage is processed independently. The model captures spatial context within an overpass but does
not exploit temporal continuity across successive passages, which could help resolve rapidly evolving boundary
layer conditions. This is a deliberate scoping choice rather than an architectural constraint.
blocks.zh:
每个轨道通道都是独立处理的. 该模型捕捉到在过山的空间背景,但确实
不利用连续通道的时间连续性,这将有助于解决迅速演变的边界问题
层层条件。 这是有意确定范围的选择,而不是建筑方面的限制。

blocks.en: 6.2 Future Work
blocks.zh: 6.2 未来工作

blocks.en: The most consequential direction follows from the label limitation discussed in Section 6.1 : replace ERA5 PBLH as the supervision signal with direct ground-based measurements, for instance from in-situ networks such as the pan-European E-PROFILE microwave radiometer and ceilometer network [ 15 ] , or the TEAMx Observational Campaign once released. This would let the retrieval be evaluated directly against observations and serve as an independent check on the reanalysis itself.
blocks.zh: 第6.1节中讨论的标签限制是:将ERA5 PBLH作为监督信号,代之以直接的地面测量,例如来自现场的网络,如泛欧E-PROFILE微波辐射计和气温计网络[15],或TEAMx观测运动一旦发布。 这样可以直接对照观测结果评估检索情况,并作为对重新分析本身的独立检查。

blocks.en: Three further directions are identified for future work. First, extending the dataset to multi-year records would improve the representation of seasonal variability and rare meteorological regimes. Second, incorporating temporally adjacent overpasses as additional context could help the model exploit the temporal continuity of boundary layer evolution and reduce errors in rapidly changing conditions. Third, the model currently outputs a single point estimate per footprint with no associated confidence; adding uncertainty quantification, for instance via quantile regression, ensembling, or conformal prediction, would let predictions be flagged by reliability, which is particularly relevant where inputs are heavily masked or reconstructed and error is expected to be higher.
blocks.zh: 为今后的工作确定了另外三个方向。 首先,将数据集扩大到多年记录将改善季节性变异和罕见气象系统的代表性。 第二,将时间相邻的过山作为附加上下文,可有助于模型利用边界层演变的时间连续性,减少快速变化条件下的错误。 第三,该模型目前每个足迹给出一个单一的点估计,没有相关的信心;增加不确定性的量化,例如通过量化回归、聚合或连贯的预测,可以使预测以可靠性标出,在投入被严重掩盖或重构而且预计误差会更高的情况下,这一点尤其相关。
